item.title: Mahfil - Safe, Curated Video Platform
item.description: Mahfil is a video-sharing and streaming platform built around safe, curated content you can actually trust. It works a lot like YouTube, but every video is reviewed to keep the experience clean, family-friendly, and free of harmful material — giving users a peaceful place to watch, share, and engage with uplifting content.
